body.x: AAUXX (CEO Jang Jin-tae) showcased its “iRing”, a grip attached to a smartphone that can also work as a stand, “iRing Dock”, an iRing assisting accessory, and “iRing Hook” at “CES (Consumer Technology Show) 2016”, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics exhibition, which runs for four days from Wednesday the 6th to Saturday the 9th at Las Vegas Convention Center (LVCC).The iRing is useful for those who break their smartphones or get them scratched. The product enables users to hold their smartphones firmly, which prevents drops and allows them to use less power.The stand function comes in handy when users watch videos and take pictures. After attaching the iRing on the back of an IT device, users can hang it in a car or set it on the floor’s edge by utilizing iRing Dock and iRing Hook.“CES”, which is held every year in January by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), is the world’s largest IT consumer electronics exhibition, showcasing global trends in the electronics and IT industry.AVING News, which has sent reporters to CES for 11 years, will introduce various up-to-date technologies and products showcased at CES 2016. Based on keen reports and research at CES, AVING News will hold the “CES 2016 Review Conference” at Korea AVING Studio on Wednesday the 28th.→ Go to 'CES 2016' news page
